workflow.name: Local business photo pack
workflow.description: Generates an on-brand photo pack for a local business (cafe, gym, salon, studio): interior, service in action, team-style shot and a seasonal promo, for Google Business Profile and social. Uses fal.ai FLUX; PNGs and a README land in Artifacts.

inputs.name: business
inputs.label: Business type and name (e.g. "Juniper, a neighbourhood specialty coffee cafe")

inputs.name: brand
inputs.label: Brand look: colours, materials, mood, location vibe
inputs.default: warm, natural light, wood and plants, friendly and modern

inputs.name: season
inputs.label: Seasonal promo theme (e.g. autumn menu, New Year membership deal)

inputs.name: perShot
inputs.label: Images per shot type (1 or 2; 4 shot types, so 4 or 8 images total)

nodes.label: Write the shot list
nodes.prompt:
You are art-directing a photo pack for a local business. Write exactly 4 image-generation prompts (max 80 words each), one per shot type, all sharing the same brand look so the set feels consistent.

Business: {{inputs.business}}
Brand look: {{inputs.brand}}
Seasonal promo theme: {{inputs.season}}

Shot types and sizes:
1. interior - the space, inviting and tidy, wide angle, no people or only distant out-of-focus figures. Size: landscape_4_3.
2. service - the core product or service in action (e.g. latte art being poured, a blow-dry, a kettlebell class), close-up on hands, tools and product. Size: square_hd.
3. team - a team-style shot of staff at work, seen from behind, in soft focus or partially framed. They must be generic, fictional people: no real person, celebrity or recognisable likeness, no faces in sharp detail. Size: portrait_4_3.
4. promo - a seasonal promo visual for the theme, styled product or scene with clean empty space for overlay text. Do not render any words, prices or logos in the image. Size: portrait_16_9.

Every prompt must be photorealistic, concrete about subject, composition, lighting and lens, and must not include text, logos, trademarks or real people.

Output only a JSON array, nothing else: [{"slug":"interior","size":"landscape_4_3","prompt":"..."}, ...] with slugs interior, service, team, promo.

nodes.label: Render with fal FLUX
nodes.prompt:
Render the shot list below with the fal.ai REST API using the model fal-ai/flux/dev and save every image.

If FAL_KEY is not set, stop and say: add FAL_KEY in Hive › Keys.

Images per shot: {{inputs.perShot}}. Treat anything other than 2 as 1. Never generate more than 8 images in total, and make only one request per shot.

For each item in the JSON array:
1. POST https://fal.run/fal-ai/flux/dev with header `Authorization: Key $FAL_KEY` and JSON body {"prompt": <item.prompt>, "image_size": <item.size>, "num_images": <images per shot>, "output_format": "png"}. Use curl; read the key from the FAL_KEY environment variable, never print, echo or log it.
2. Download each images[i].url into "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/<slug>-<i+1>.png" (e.g. "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/interior-1.png").
3. If one request fails, retry it once, then continue with the rest and note the failure.

Reply with a list of saved file paths, each followed by its shot type, size and the exact prompt used, plus any failures.

Shot list:
{{brief.output}}

nodes.label: Write the README
nodes.prompt:
Write a short "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/README.md" for this photo pack.

Include: a title with the business ({{inputs.business}}), the model used (fal.ai fal-ai/flux/dev), a table of files (file name, shot type, size, suggested use: Google Business Profile cover/interior/products/team, Instagram post or story) and the exact prompt used for each file. Add a short note that these are AI-generated images with fictional people, they should not be presented as real staff or customers, and the promo image is left without text so a caption or offer can be added in a design tool. Only list files that exist in "$ARTIFACTS_DIR"; never include API keys.

Reply with the README path and the list of images.

Render report:
{{render.output}}
